title: DP147 Long-Term Unemployment, Excess Demand and the Wage Equation in Britain, 1925-39
title_zh: DP147 英国长期失业、超额需求与工资方程（1925-1939）
authors: Nicholas Crafts
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The relationship between unemployment and the rate of change of money wages in interwar Britain is re-examined. It is argued that improved estimates of the wage equation can be obtained by taking account explicitly of factors which change the level of excess demand associated with the measured unemployment rate. In particular, the evidence suggests that long-term unemployment did not act as a restraint on the growth of money wages. New estimates of the wage equation imply that the NAIRU rose during the 1930s as the proportion of unemployment that was long term was higher than in the late 1920s.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了两次世界大战期间英国失业率与货币工资变动率之间的关系。研究表明，通过明确考虑那些改变与实测失业率相关的超额需求水平的因素，可以获得对工资方程的更优估计。具体而言，证据表明长期失业并未对货币工资增长起到抑制作用。工资方程的新估计表明，由于20世纪30年代长期失业占比高于20年代末，该时期的非加速通货膨胀失业率有所上升。

title: Strategic Limit Orders and Intertemporal Price Dispersion
title_zh: 战略限价订单与跨期价格离散
authors: Banerjee, Suman, Jagannathan, Ravi, Wang, Kai
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study a two-period commodity market with competitive consumers and Cournot sellers. Without speculation, equilibrium is stationary. A storage-capable, strategically large speculator can profitably create deterministic intertemporal price dispersion using standard order types. A period-1 limit buy order flattens residual demand, induces higher output, and yields a low purchase price. With mandatory liquidation, resale remains below the no-speculation price but above the purchase price, so the speculator profits; consumers gain and sellers lose. With free disposal and a stop-loss, the period-2 price can exceed the benchmark, benefiting sellers but harming consumers.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个包含竞争性消费者和古诺卖方的两期商品市场。在没有投机的情况下，市场均衡是稳定的。一个具备仓储能力且规模较大的策略性投机者，能够利用标准订单类型，有确定性地创造跨期价格差异。第一期的限价买入订单会压低剩余需求，促使产量增加，并形成较低的购买价格。在强制清算条件下，转售价格仍低于无投机时的价格，但高于购买价格，因此投机者获利；消费者受益，而卖方受损。在允许自由处置并设置止损的情况下，第二期价格可能超过基准水平，从而使卖方受益，但损害消费者利益。

title: Food Price Crises and the Insulation of Domestic Grain Markets
title_zh: 粮食价格危机与国内谷物市场的隔离
authors: Clemens Hoffmann, Lina Kastens, Alberto Portugal‐Perez, Stephan von Cramon‐Taubadel
abstract: Studies that analyze the transmission of food prices from international to domestic markets for large sets of countries and products assume that price relationships are time‐invariant. However, studies that look in detail at individual countries and products show that countries respond to increasing international food prices with measures that increase the insulation of their domestic markets and thus weaken international‐to‐domestic price transmission. We analyze relationships between international prices and a large set of domestic prices for wheat, yellow and white maize, and rice using a smooth‐transition error correction model. This specification relaxes the assumption of time‐invariant price transmission by allowing price relationships and domestic market insulation to vary over time depending on international price levels. The results confirm that international‐to‐domestic price transmission weakens in many countries during periods of high international prices, such as 2007/08 and 2022. Our findings highlight a collective action problem: as more countries insulate, the global trading system's capacity to buffer shocks diminishes, amplifying volatility and food security risks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 针对多国多产品国际与国内食品价格传导关系的研究，通常假设价格关系具有时间不变性。然而，聚焦单个国家与产品的细化研究表明，各国面对国际食品价格上涨时，会采取增强国内市场隔离度的措施，从而削弱国际与国内价格之间的传导效应。本文采用平滑转换误差修正模型，分析国际价格与小麦、黄玉米、白玉米及大米等大量国内价格之间的关系。该模型通过允许价格关系及国内市场隔离度随国际价格水平动态变化，突破了时间不变性假设的局限。研究结果证实，在国际价格高涨时期（如2007/08年度及2022年），许多国家的国际-国内价格传导效应显著减弱。这一发现揭示了集体行动困境：随着更多国家采取隔离措施，全球贸易体系缓冲冲击的能力持续下降，进而加剧价格波动与粮食安全风险。

title: Importer dispersion and exchange rate pass‐through
title_zh: 进口商分散度与汇率传递效应
authors: Qingyuan Du, Yalin Liu, Jianwei Xu
abstract: This paper examines the impact of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through. Theoretically, we demonstrate that greater importer dispersion – characterized by larger variations in import size across importers – leads to higher demand elasticity and lower exporter markups, thereby resulting in greater exchange rate pass‐through. Using transaction‐level customs data from Colombia, we provide robust empirical evidence supporting this prediction. The quantitative effect of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through is significant: the importer dispersion channel is at least as important as the traditional exporter heterogeneity channel. Our results are robust to various empirical specifications and become even stronger in the context of the dominant currency paradigm.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了进口商分散度对汇率传递的影响。理论上，我们证明更大的进口商分散度——表现为各进口商进口规模差异更大——会导致更高的需求弹性和更低的出口商加成定价，从而产生更强的汇率传递效应。利用哥伦比亚交易层面的海关数据，我们提供了支持这一预测的稳健实证证据。进口商分散度对汇率传递的量化影响显著：该渠道的重要性至少与传统出口商异质性渠道相当。我们的结论在多种实证设定下保持稳健，且在主导货币范式背景下更为显著。

title: The Effect of the Federal Reserve on the Stock Market: Magnitudes, Channels and Shocks
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
authors: Benjamin Knox, Annette Vissing-Jorgensen
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We survey and extend work on the Federal Reserve’s effect on the stock market, focusing on three empirical findings: The effect of monetary policy surprises in a narrow window around announcements from the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the pre-FOMC announcement drift, and the FOMC cycle in stock returns. We discuss the magnitude of the Fed’s impact (directional effects or effects on average stock returns), the types of shocks coming from the Fed (pure monetary policy shocks, reaction function news, or information about the Fed’s view of the economy), and the asset pricing channels through which effects emerge (an equity premia for news from the Fed, or changes to yields, equity premia, or expected dividends). We also consider the information transmission (communication) channels. The Fed’s effect on the stock market is large, even for average stock returns earned over periods of several decades. Fed-induced changes to both yields and equity premia play substantial roles, with less direct evidence available regarding cash flows. For stocks, reaction function news appears to be more important than Fed information effects. Communication flows outside announcements windows are important.
abstract_zh: 本文综述并拓展了关于美联储对股票市场影响的研究，重点关注三项实证发现：联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告前后窄窗口期内货币政策冲击的影响、FOMC公告前的漂移现象，以及股票收益中的FOMC周期。我们探讨了美联储影响的程度（方向性效应或对平均股票收益的影响）、来自美联储的冲击类型（纯货币政策冲击、反应函数信息或美联储对经济看法的信息），以及效应产生的资产定价渠道（美联储消息的股权溢价，或收益率、股权溢价、预期股息的变化）。我们还考虑了信息传递（沟通）渠道。美联储对股票市场的影响是巨大的，即使是在数十年期间获得的平均股票收益方面也是如此。美联储引发的收益率和股权溢价变化均发挥了重要作用，而关于现金流的直接证据较少。对于股票而言，反应函数信息似乎比美联储信息效应更为重要。公告窗口外的沟通流动具有重要影响。

title: Breaking Echo Chambers: An Experimental Study on the Willingness to Listen to Opposite Views
title_zh: 打破回音室：倾听对立观点意愿的实验研究
authors: Michèle Belot, Guglielmo Briscese
abstract: This study examines the willingness to engage with others who hold opposing views, a key and understudied step for reducing polarization. A sample of 2,507 Americans is offered the opportunity to listen to opposing views on immigration, abortion and gun ownership. We find that, at baseline, a large fraction of participants are willing to listen, even without incentives and with an easy way out. Emphasizing common ground increases the willingness to engage and reconsider views on abortion and immigration. We discuss possible mechanisms that can explain increased engagement. We propose that emphasizing common ground increases the value of communication as a means to reason through an issue. These findings point to promising directions for interventions aimed at fostering dialogue across ideological divides.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人们与持对立观点者进行交流的意愿，这是减少极化过程中一个关键但尚未充分研究的环节。通过对2507名美国民众进行抽样调查，我们提供了倾听关于移民、堕胎和枪支管制等议题对立观点的机会。研究发现，在基线条件下，即使没有激励措施且存在便捷的退出途径，仍有相当比例的参与者愿意倾听。强调共同立场能够提升参与者就堕胎和移民议题进行交流并重新审视自身观点的意愿。我们探讨了可能解释这种参与度提升的潜在机制，并提出强调共同立场能够增强沟通作为理性探讨议题工具的价值。这些发现为旨在促进跨意识形态对话的干预措施指明了有前景的方向。

title: Lobbying and rotating leadership
title_zh: 游说与轮值领导
authors: Philippe van Gruisen
abstract: Economic and political decisions are increasingly made in international organizations (IOs). A distinctive feature of many IOs is that they operate under a system of rotating leadership (e.g. a committee chair that rotates annually). Despite the widespread use of such systems and their potential value to interest groups, we know surprisingly little about how interest groups respond to rotating leadership in IOs. Using both micro- and macro-level data on the economic performance of commercial lobbyists in the European Union, I show that interest groups respond strategically to short-term shifts in leadership. Specifically, when a country takes over the rotating EU Council Presidency, interest groups increase their use of commercial lobbyists to gain access to policymakers from the presiding country.
abstract_zh: 经济与政治决策越来越多地在国际组织（IOs）中作出。许多国际组织的一个显著特征是，它们采用轮值领导制度（例如，委员会主席每年轮换）。尽管这种制度被广泛采用，且对利益集团具有潜在价值，但我们对利益集团如何应对国际组织中的轮值领导制度知之甚少。利用欧盟商业游说者经济表现的微观与宏观层面数据，我揭示了利益集团会策略性地应对短期领导权更迭。具体而言，当一个国家接任欧盟理事会轮值主席国时，利益集团会增加对商业游说者的使用，以获取与主席国政策制定者接触的渠道。

title: Universal free meals and school suspensions
title_zh: 全民免费校餐与停学处分
authors: Andres Cuadros‐Meñaca, Di Fang, Rodolfo M. Nayga, Michael R. Thomsen
abstract: We examine whether providing free school meals to all students causes changes in out‐of‐school suspensions for schools adopting those policies in the United States. Using updated data and modern difference‐in‐differences methods that account for staggered adoption, we show suspensions fall by approximately 10% in elementary schools and 6% in middle and high schools, with larger effects in schools that previously served fewer students eligible for free and reduced‐price meals in preadoption periods. These findings contrast with earlier null results, primarily due to better methods that account for staggered program adoption as opposed to the updated dataset.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国实施免费校餐政策后，该政策是否导致学校校外停学处分的变化。采用更新后的数据及考虑交错采纳的现代双重差分方法，我们发现小学停学率下降约10%，初中和高中下降约6%，且在政策实施前享受免费或减价餐食资格学生较少的学校中效果更为显著。这些发现与早期零结果形成对比，主要归因于采用更优方法处理交错采纳效应，而非数据更新本身。

title: Ownership Dynamics and Firm Policies with a Large Shareholder
title_zh: 大股东持股下的所有权动态与企业政策
authors: Sebastian Gryglewicz, Simon Mayer, Erwan Morellec
official: 官方在线 2026-02-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of large shareholders and firm policies, where a blockholder engages with the firm to improve asset productivity and influence decisions on investment, financing, and executive compensation. In equilibrium, the blockholder’s ownership stake may grow or shrink over time driven by gains from trade that result from the relationship between ownership, corporate policies, and control. A feedback loop emerges: as the blockholder increases their ownership, it boosts investment and the firm's debt capacity, while higher returns from debt and investment incentivize the blockholder to increase their stake. While firm policies need not maximize dispersed shareholder value when the blockholder is in control, limiting blockholder influence ultimately reduces blockholder ownership and firm value.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于大股东与企业政策动态关系的理论模型。在该模型中，大宗持股者通过参与公司治理提升资产生产率，并影响投资、融资及高管薪酬等决策。在均衡状态下，大宗持股者的所有权份额会随时间推移而增减，这种变化源于所有权结构、企业政策与控制权之间的交易收益关系。由此形成反馈循环：当大宗持股者增持股份时，会促进投资并提升企业债务容量，而债务与投资带来的更高回报又激励其进一步增持。尽管在大宗持股者控制下，企业政策未必能最大化分散股东价值，但限制其影响力最终将导致持股比例下降与企业价值受损。
